claims.text: First-line topicals: metronidazole cream or gel, clindamycin lotion or gel, erythromycin gel, topical sulfur, azelaic acid gel
claims.quote: First-line treatment options for perioral dermatitis include metronidazole cream or gel, clindamycin lotion or gel, erythromycin gel, topical sulfur preparations, and azelaic acid gel.

claims.text: Topical erythromycin 2% or metronidazole 0.75% gel or cream 2 times a day
claims.quote: Topical antibiotics (eg, erythromycin 2% or metronidazole 0.75% gel or cream 2 times a day) are helpful.
